dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Adventure Challenge

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Duel

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Whoa! You're even better than Cyrus...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Yeah! My training has paid off!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Darn... I must continue my training...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: It is what it is! My card training has finally paid off!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This is bad... This is really bad...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's wrong?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Oh, you're... the traveler. *sigh* You must have seen the storm that hit us, too. All of Mondstadt's a mess right now.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Cyrus said that we need to stop monsters from taking this opportunity to attack us. So he put out commissions for adventurers to scout their movements out.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: My next commission was to observe the monsters around the Thousand Winds Temple, so I confirmed my tasking and left.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: At the Temple, I saw a large group of monsters gathering together, and I tried to get a closer look...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But I didn't expect to be discovered almost immediately upon getting closer. If a passing adventurer hadn't come to my rescue, I wouldn't have made it.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: We left the Thousand Winds Temple for fear of being attacked by more monsters, and came back to Mondstadt.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: And that's when I realized... that I had left my Adventurer Handbook and map at the Temple.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: But there's no way I can go to get it back like this...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Traveler, would you be willing to help me go to the Thousand Winds Temple and retrieve my map and Adventurer Handbook?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Thank you so much. *sigh* Honestly, it's a bit embarrassing...

choices.text: Why were you there in the first place...

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: Ugh, this is a bit embarrassing... Do you know of the Adventurer Rank Rating?

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I thought that if I could show my stuff a bit more, I could get through the rating process safely.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: But I never thought that... *sigh* Please, help me get my map and Adventurer Handbook back.

response.speaker: Jack
response.text: I need to be more careful in future...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey! Are you a new adventurer? Wanna join my adventure team?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hey, I'm doing some adventurer's training... alcohol tolerance training, to be precise... Wanna join me?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Tell me about yourself.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm Jack. Just Jack. No need to be formal with me, since we're all friends here.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I joined a few months ago, and people here helped me out lots.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Especially those stories! Oh, they are so exciting and always get me pumped up!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Hahaha... So far, I've only completed small commissions like clearing the sewers of a few slimes...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* When can I be like the others...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Adventure team?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Yeah, people here usually band together in groups of four to go on adventures.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: You seem to be in good company.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I once belonged to a rather nice team... But "Unlucky Bennett" was also there...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: We all thought it was just a joke about him being "unlucky," but...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: All the commissions he took on, somehow always failed in the least expected way...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Come to think of it, it is rather strange.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Ad astra abyssosque! May Lady Luck smile upon you, friend.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Stormterror...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: To tell the truth, I was worried at first. But I was also excited.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: This was my first time seeing a dragon. Just thinking that I might be able to face such a fearsome opponent gets me pumped up!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: If I could finish a commission of that rank, I would definitely rise to prominence throughout the entire Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: *sigh* But as it stands, I can only take some commissions to clear out a few slimes here and there. I'm going to have a work a lot harder if I'm to take a dragon on...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem to have had one too many.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Really? Let me see... eight beers, five wines, seven ciders... Not so much!

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: I'm no match for those legendary Mondstadt adventurers who can drink half of Cider Lake's worth of wine...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: ...Only a figure of speech? Really? No wonder... I could never figure out how they could afford so much wine on an adventurer's income...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of liquor do you prefer?

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Me...? Beer. I don't like it that much though...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: It's just that... beggars can't be choosers...

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: As long as it gets me drunk, it's all good... Don't you agree?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Jack
dialogues.text: Laters! Happy adventuring!
